Header.value: Sri Lankan Legal NER - information extraction, not legal advice
FUNDAMENTAL_RIGHT: an explicitly protected right or freedom
OFFENSE: an act or omission expressly made punishable
PENALTY: a fine, imprisonment, forfeiture, or other punishment
CONSTITUTIONAL_BODY: the official name of a constitutional institution or office
TEMPORAL_ENTITY: a date, duration, deadline, or frequency
Use no label when none applies. Do not label Article, Section, Act, or amendment references.
